result.rationale: The diff confirms `await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests);` passes the raw input `guests` rather than the computed `uniqueGuests`. In email-manager.ts, any attendee whose email is in the passed list receives `AttendeeScheduledEmail` (the original booking email) instead of `AttendeeAddGuestsEmail`. Since `uniqueGuests` explicitly filters out emails already present among `booking.attendees`, a mixed request containing an existing attendee's email will cause that existing attendee to be re-sent the original 'scheduled' email — a real, verifiable defect introduced by this diff.
